work.abstract_text: We extend Ma and Zhang's negative answer (2026, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24391331, Section 2) to the surjectivity question in Delgado, Süer and Yeşil, A Symmetrization for Almost Symmetric Numerical Semigroups (arXiv:2611.14268v1, Section 5, p. 9, final paragraph): the row-deletion map omits not only targets containing 1, but also some reduced symmetric targets whose diagrams have no full cell below the diagonal. The ordered output elements satisfy b_i >= 2i; equality at b_1 = 2 forces every element below the conductor to be even. The smallest excluded reduced target has Frobenius number 7; under the full-cell restriction the minimum is 9. We give infinite excluded families, retain the exact ordinary fiber and fixed-point characterization, and distinguish fixed-source image bounds from fixed-target counts.
